text:
Sam: Quick async sync on console observability roadmap — status + asks. TL;DR: dashboards canary deployed, tracing hooks PR open, error-analysis MVP in staging (target EOW), retention policy needs cost sign-off. Details below.

Jess: thanks — can you call out owners + any blockers? Also who needs to review the tracing PR?

Sam: owners: dashboards = Sam, tracing hooks = Omar, error analysis = Irene, retention/cost = Jess -> finance. Blockers: retention cost estimate, one perf regression seen in staging dashboard tile rendering.

Omar: PR is up: https://git.internal/r/redwood/console/tree/obs-tracing-hooks (branch: obs/tracing/hooks)
Omar: main change is instrumenting the api-proxy + adding trace context propagation to websocket streaming. Small runtime cost expected (+0.5-1% CPU) but should be fine. Asking @Sam and @Jess for review.

observability-bot: Deployment staging/console-observability succeeded — commit 9f3b2c4 — canary group: 10% traffic. Logs: /deploys/1761004800

Jess: saw the perf blip on dashboards earlier — Pete noticed 95p tile latency jumped to ~210ms for ~10m window. Is that correlated with the canary?

Sam: investigating — initial hypothesis: a cache TTL mismatch on the metrics proxy. Rolling a hotfix branch now. Will report back in ~30m.

Irene: error-analysis MVP in staging — features: group by stacktrace, aggregate by model & prompt-hash, basic CSV export. Acceptance criteria: filter by time/model/prompt, grouping accuracy >= 90% on our eval set, and export includes top 5 error examples per group. I'll drop the eval set to the PR.

Omar: thx Irene. For tracing hooks, we added a quick smoke test. Run locally:
```
# run smoke test against local proxy
curl -H 'traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01' http://localhost:8080/api/health
```
If trace id flows through, you should see X-Trace-Id in backend logs.

Jess: retention: finance ran rough numbers. Keeping raw logs 90d + aggregated metrics 365d ~estimated cost $5.8k/mo on current ingest. 30d raw + 365d agg is $2.1k/mo. Need decision on compliance tier.

Sam: propose staged retention: 30d raw by default, opt-in 90d for enterprise customers, aggregated metrics 365d for everyone. Jess — can you run contract language + MRR impact for opt-in?

Jess: will do. Also we should add a feature flag to flip retention per org — low lift, I'll create ticket and tag eng-platform.

Omar: about the canary/perf blip — if hotfix doesn't clear it, we should rollback canary and open a perf incident. What's our rollback window?

Sam: rollback if 95p > 180ms for more than 15m or error rate +0.5pp. Canary window is 30m total; current canary at 10% will be stopped if thresholds crossed.

Irene: I'll drop the eval dataset and test cases into the error-analysis PR by EOD. Also pinging @Omar for any tracing-specific adjustments needed for grouping logic.

Sam: asks: (1) @Jess — can you confirm finance + contract impact by Tue? (2) @Omar — please request 1-2 reviewers on PR and add the smoke test to CI. (3) @Irene — please attach eval set and define grouping metric.

Jess: on it, will coordinate with finance and send numbers + proposed opt-in phrasing by Tue. :thumbsup:

Omar: added reviewers (anna, marco) and CI smoke tests in branch. Will follow up if perf hotspots show.

observability-bot: Canary snapshot: 10% traffic, 2026-04-01T15:30Z, metrics: tile_95p=160ms, error_rate=0.18%

Sam: ok — thanks everyone. I'll pause the canary if the hotfix doesn't resolve the TTL issue. If you have quick reviews, please do them today so we can get tracing hooks merged before EOW.

Jess: quick Q — do we need security review for storing extended traces (90d)? I think privacy needs to sign off. Adding security review ticket.

Irene: noted — I'll include privacy checklist with sample data redaction examples.

Sam: final note: next sync on this will be Friday async update. Ping here for any blockers. :sparkles:
